name: Doing What Is Right
overview: Scripture calls believers to actively pursue righteousness by doing what is right in every aspect of life. Isaiah 1:17 urges us to seek justice and care for the vulnerable, while James 4:17 reminds us that knowing what is good and failing to do it is sin. Galatians 6:9 encourages perseverance in well-doing with the promise of a future reward, and Colossians 3:17 instructs that all actions be done in the name of the Lord Jesus with gratitude. Ephesians 5:1 calls believers to imitate God as beloved children, demonstrating that doing what is right is a reflection of our relationship with Him.
